direct_initialization: explicit zero bilinear matrix; selected because historical direct initial checkpoint is zero and identity/cosine are read-only controls, not trained controls
execution_note: Executed under owner directive; no manifest threshold or budget changes.
mandatory_stops: any attempt to interpret this as latent-language-model conditioning
scientific_scope: query-conditioned associative memory versus conventional retrieval and trainable direct ranking; not language-model latent conditioning

thresholds.complete_required_evidence_at_5: associative must exceed both conventional cosine and direct control on the independent corpus without lowering hit_rate_at_1 by more than 0.05 relative to the better trainable-control baseline
thresholds.first_result: associative hit_rate_at_1 must not regress more than 0.05 against the predeclared direct control
thresholds.resource: all guards pass and no run exceeds established limits
